Changelog

Latest changes and updates to Insomnia

Jul 24, 202613.1.0

Notable Changes

  • Git Sync projects can now be stored anywhere on disk. Select an existing on-disk folder to use it as a Git Sync project, or create a new folder anywhere when creating a new Git Sync project. This version also handles some edge cases better: automatically creating & tracking branches if the remote is empty, no longer requiring base URLs for credentials.
  • Your ~/.gitconfig settings are now available within Insomnia, making it even easier to get started with Git Sync projects.

Improvements & Features

  • Modals now guard against data loss if multiple unsaved changes exist when a modal is being dismissed. (INS-2551) #10068 #10097
  • Cmd/Ctrl+N in the sidebar can now be used to create any supported object (Documents, Mock Servers, GraphQL requests, etc). (INS-2663) #10189
  • Collection runner now provides more granular feedback during a run, and a better structured post-run report format. (INS-2627) #10193
  • The Preferences > Software Updates > Check button now holds the “Downloading” message while a new version is being downloaded. (INS-696) #10110 #10147
  • Added first-class support for the QUERY HTTP method #10157
  • Expanded cURL import to support more cURL flags and features (INS-1531) #10096
  • Added support for template variables in WebSocket request paths #10067
  • Added local search/filter to the organization selector, if there are enough organizations for it to be useful (INS-2761) #10056
  • Export option added to the project context menu (INS-2552) #10198
  • Mock servers now support creation of different verbs for each path (INS-2629) #10136
  • Logging using insomnia.environment in pre/post-scripts now actually log available KV-pairs. (INS-2806) #10164
  • Plugin manifest permissions are now displayed in the Plugins UI #10211
  • QuickJS templating sandbox (behind feature flag) with capability-gated host bridge, manifest-gated module registry, and stdlib globals (Buffer/process/crypto/URL) #10207, #10208, #10220, #10222

Jun 16, 202613.0.0

Breaking Changes

  • Plugin Security Enhancements: Plugins can no longer directly access Node.js, which may break some older plugins.
  • Template Tags engine updated from Nunchuks to LiquidJS. All major functionality still exists and has wbeen tested. Some minor syntax changes will require manual user intervention.

Learn more @ https://insomnia.rest/breaking-changes

Notable Changes

  • New tree-based sidebar shows you all your projects and files at once, making it easier than ever to navigate quickly between work items. A context menu makes it easy to quickly take any action. New breadcrumb makes it easy to understand where in the hierarchy you are or access related items. Env picker, cookies and certificates moved to top right. INS-2267
  • Native integration with Kong Konnect means your control planes and routes are synced as Collections and Requests. Sync any time you want to always be up to date with Konnect, while automatically maintaining your local changes. Authenticates via Konnect PAT for v13, oAuth will be supported in Q3. INS-2268
  • A new home screen makes it easy to create your first request, including examples of common request types. INS-2379

Improvements & Features

  • Spectral linting is now supported in all project types—Local, Cloud Sync, and Git Sync—with an improved flow for adding or replacing the ruleset file, and a more succinct grouped listing of errors & warnings. INS-2338
  • Move non-UI and value-added functionality like plugins out of the renderer process & disable nodeIntegration for a more secure renderer process execution environment. This improves the overall security stance of the product by isolating plugin code from the app’s main context. INS-1779
  • Migrate templating engine from Nunjucks to LiquidJS. INS-2195
  • Polish the Git Sync migration onboarding flow and improve discoverability of local project file access across the app. INS-2462
  • Adds default user-agent handling and a hint when users override the default Host header.
  • Add an additional configuration option to specify an API token when specifying an LLM provider. INS-2146
  • Display app version in window title. INS-2465

Bugfixes

  • Fix inherited folder auth not applied for OAuth2 requests INS-2671
  • Fix header editors misalignment #10061
  • Fix app crash when no writable stdout is available #9984
  • Fix deep link handling in insomniaFetch #9977
  • Fix PDF rendering failures by using blob URL in PDF preview iframe.
  • Fixes a bug which would prevent the name of collections et al from being updated if the filename is unchanged. INS-2621
  • Keep auth status synced across multiple app windows. INS-2537

Maintenance

  • Upgrades Playwright DX, adds Konnect smoke tests, fixes feature-flag mock leak in export tests, removes unnecessary seeding, improves stability, and enables E2E runs on release branches.
  • Security dependency updates #9884
  • Upgrade Github actions from Node 20 to Node 24 runtime #9983
  • insomnia-data package extraction — Refactors shared data utilities, base types, and model imports into a standalone workspace package.
May 22, 202612.6.0

Notable Changes

Git Sync projects are now stored on disk and can be manipulated using tools like git, claude, etc., or the IDEs of your choice (VS Code, etc). Insomnia picks up on-disk changes in real-time and reflects them in the GUI.

Any Git functionality not available via the Insomnia UI can be done from the CLI (rebase, revert, commit individual chunks, etc) #9789 INS-1892

Improvements & Features

  • The pre and post-request script execution environment has been revamped with enhanced security controls, giving users more granular control over script permissions and module access. #9794
  • Importing a cURL command now automatically includes a default User-Agent header, improving compatibility with APIs that require one. INS-2416 #9838
  • A new setting in Preferences > Plugins lets users specify a custom npm registry URL for plugin installation, making it easier to install plugins in corporate or restricted network environments. INS-1269 #9837
  • The default action when deleting a cloud-synced workspace has been updated to give users clearer control over whether data is removed locally, remotely, or both. INS-2308 #9844

Bugfixes

  • During a Git merge, non-YAML files that cannot be merged are now automatically resolved to the remote version, preventing confusing failures for binary or unsupported file types. INS-2364 #9798
  • Updated the underlying networking library to resolve connectivity issues and improve support for IPv6 networks. #9869
  • Fixed an issue where pinning and unpinning WebSocket and Socket.IO requests was not functioning correctly. #9865
  • Error messages shown when mock route creation fails are now more descriptive, making it easier to understand what went wrong. INS-478 #9841
  • Fixed a security issue in the AI plugin where file paths were not routed through the secure path handler, which could allow access to files outside of the intended directory. INS-2244 #9748
  • Resolved a recurring error where unresolved Promises were incorrectly being surfaced as error messages. #9786
  • Fixed an unhandled promise rejection that could occur during template rendering, improving app stability. #9774

Maintenance

  • User account and authentication data is now fetched via the latest API version, improving long-term reliability and compatibility. #9785
  • Commented out SMCTL credentials save step in release workflow #9898
  • Added a local Git server for smoke tests INS-2258 #9816
  • Updated insomnia-plugin-ai to latest version #9862
  • Moved sync code execution to the main process #9827
  • Moved auth header handling to the main process #9834
  • Decoupled release workflows for independent deployments #9842
  • Migrated OAuth session storage to Electron store #9851
  • Resolved GitHub Actions warning annotations and reduced CI pipeline duration INS-2312 #9839
  • Applied Principle of Least Privilege to CI/CD workflows #9840
  • Isolated gRPC proto file preparation behind an IPC boundary #9828
  • Moved Konnect sync behind a feature flag for controlled rollout #9832
  • Added e2e and CLI agent skills documentation #9818
  • Cleaned up shared browser-safe helper utilities #9810
  • Cleaned up filesystem-backed route code #9806
  • Added AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md documentation #9812
  • Removed built-in route path imports #9805
  • Tightened renderer Node.js API surface #9803
  • Moved model migration and initModel logic to the database layer #9796
  • Analytics tracking has been added for user actions in the project empty state view, helping us improve future onboarding experiences. INS-2461 #9910
  • Fixed a navigation error that occurred during view transitions, improving overall app stability. INS-2316 #9792
  • Resolved a security-related dependency issue that could affect certain configurations. INS-2366 #9852

Nov 3, 202512.0.0

Notable Changes

MCP clients

You can now create Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients in Insomnia to interact with MCP servers. Discover tools, resources, and more and inspect client-server communication events in detail. MCP clients remain local at the moment, and are not included in git workflows.

Commit suggestions

Insomnia can now help you leverage LLMs to suggest commit messages & file groupings, so you can worry less about organizing your work and focus on actually getting things done. You can use providers like Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini or run any model locally for full control over where your data goes.

Mock server generation

Mock servers can now also be generated from OpenAPI specifications, URLs, or text descriptions by leveraging LLMs. As with commit suggestions, you can use a local model of your choice or offload the processing to a popular provider for quick iteration.

Improvements & Features

  • Improve performance of conflict resolution modal when reconciling tens of thousands of lines. INS-1425 #9268
  • Add support for automatically opening the Insomnia app on completion of an OAuth flow. INS-1263 #9089
  • Enable ID replacement when importing. INS-1486 #9162 #9256

Bugfixes

  • Fix an issue where context menu events from the request settings modal were affecting the outer menu interface. INS-1536 #9257

  • Address issues which can sometimes occur when importing cURL INS-1502 INS-1503 #9163 #9151 #9197 #9198
  • Performance improvements to the rendering of the Events tab for Websocket & SocketIO requests. INS-1423 #9157
  • Streamline Git Sync configuration modal to better handle & present error states. INS-1309 #9181
  • Update branch naming rules to be consistent with Git guidelines. INS-1041 #9126
  • Use toasts to reliably show status when checking for updates via the macOS toolbar option. INS-1311 #9128
  • Correctly handle floating point OAuth token expiry timestamps. INS-1485 #9170 #9182
  • Improve consistency in modal behavior across the app. #9190
  • Fix outdated reference to momentjs, replace with date-fns. #9225

Full Changelog: https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/compare/core@11.6.1...core@11.6.2

Sep 18, 202511.6.1

Bugfixes & Improvements

  • Hashicorp Vault Dedicated is now supported for managing credentials in light of the EOS announcement for HCP Vault Secrets. INS-1290 #9082
  • The .git extension is no longer enforced when creating a Git Sync project using a token/password. INS-1054 #9086
  • Include headers when refreshing OAuth token. #8946 #8947
  • Various improvements to the UX of accessing & working within the Scratchpad. INS-529 #9123
  • The conflict resolution modal now expands to utilize all available screen real estate, giving you more room to work with. #9133
  • Pinned requests can now be unpinned by double clicking the thumbtack icon. #9127
Sep 11, 202511.6.0

Notable Changes

  • Conflicts can be resolved change by change and even allows for bespoke changes during the resolution process, so you can just get stuff done. INS-908 INS-1193 #9052
  • Users on the Enterprise plan now have the option to import multiple projects in one shot, making it considerably easier to move their existing work from other tools into Insomnia. INS-703 #9047

Improvements & Features

  • Socket.IO requests now support Auth. INS-1270 #9066
  • Errors presented when importing a collection now note which specific fields are causing the import to fail. INS-1250 #9048
  • Pushing or pulling when committing all local changes can be done slightly faster now with the “Commit and pull” or “Commit and push” buttons. INS-1282 #9069
  • Includes additional performance improvements when interacting with large collections with hundreds or thousands of requests. INS-1075 #8948
  • Provides some improvement to the performance of rendering template tags. #9058
  • OpenAPI lint errors caused by references to security schemes not defined within the schema will now display a specific error message instead of a generic one. INS-443 #2072 #8736
  • The error message presented when attempting to access disk locations which haven’t been explicitly allowed has been improved to make it very clear that Insomnia preferences need to be updated to allow the action. INS-1277 #9076

Bugfixes

  • Fix binary signing for the Windows Insomnia artifact. INS-1113 #9081
  • Pulling or discarding changes will no longer remove items not technically tracked via git, like private environments. INS-994 #9100
  • Fixes a bug which was leading to persistent 401 errors when connecting to a remote repository using a token. INS-1234 #9092
  • Switching to a different request within a collection will no longer clear filters in the sidebar. INS-1056 #8591 #8961
  • Fixes an issue which would lead to an error being thrown sometimes when deleting a collection. INS-1251 #9060
  • Fixes an issue which could sometimes cause pre-request scripts to run forever. INS-1262 #9031 #8897 #9059
  • Using the --ci flag with inso now does a better job of selecting an environment and also cleans up any internal warnings for a cleaner output. INS-1345 #9108
  • The cookie modal is now scrollable and usable even with very long cookie values configured. INS-1340 #9087 #9095
  • Fixes an issue which sometimes caused errors when updating to a new version and immediately creating a new request. #9101
  • Deleting the current project will now reliably navigate the app back to the organization instead of sometimes crashing the app. INS-1189 #9068
  • Fixes a race condition which sometimes led to incorrect project contents being listed when switching between projects. INS-1253 #9049
  • Fixes an issue which would cause an error when navigating through the Preferences modal without logging in. INS-1357 #9113

Maintenance

  • Bump vite to v7.x #8842
  • Speed up CI run time by removing superfluous app restarts between tests. #9071
Aug 26, 202511.5.0

Notable Changes

  • Scripts & template tags which attempt to access files on the local disk are now restricted to an allowlist of directories which are configured in the app preferences. This release of inso introduces additional flags, -f or --dataFolders, to control disk access as well! INS-1062 INS-1064 #8953 #8955

Improvements & Features

  • Collaborating via git has been streamlined to improve the experience of pushing to or pulling from a repository even there are changes on both local and remote. INS-907 INS-913 #8984
  • You can now navigate through large projects with thousands of requests without a noticeable lag. INS-694 #8805
  • Insomnia now lets you work on Git Sync projects locally without having to connect a remote. You only have to connect a remote when it comes time to commit your changes. INS-810 #8906
  • Requests using OAuth 2.0 now also have the option of using the default browser instead of the built-in one in Insomnia. INS-817 #8303 #5838 #8863
  • The conflict resolution GUI has been improved to display important icons and buttons at all times rather than just on hover. INS-910 #9007

Bugfixes

  • Spectral linting within a design document, which stopped working in v11.4.0, will function as expected now with the default lint rules. INS-1190 #9022
  • Deleting a project while having it open will no longer cause the app to crash occasionally. INS-979 #8931
  • The scroll position of the request body is now maintained when a request is sent. INS-1105 #8930 #8962
  • Fixed a race condition that led to unpredictable and seemingly random duplicate projects, projects of the incorrect type, etc. INS-1107 #8985
  • Folder environment variables will also be included in the editor auto-complete list. INS-1109 #8787 #8983
  • SocketIO requests couldn’t be created directly within a folder using the folder context menu. This has been fixed now, so there’s less dragging and dropping to do. INS-1172 #9010
  • Concocting unusually large URLs, think 10,000+ characters, will no longer cause the app to become unresponsive. The app will instead nicely inform you that the URL is too long to be handled. INS-977 #8858 #8898
  • Re-enabled the MD5 hashing function which was momentarily broken in the last release. #8956
  • Fixed a minor GUI bug which would cause the list of environments to occlude collection environments as the lists grow. INS-978 #8831 #8898

Maintenance

  • Replace lodash with es-toolkit. #8909
  • Bump the electron version to v37. #8963 #8978
Jul 30, 202511.4.0

Improvements & Features

  • Working with git has a much improved experience now with feedback & clearer messaging for common operations and the ability to choose a branch when cloning a repository. INS-811 INS-911 #8883 #8891 #8905

  • Insomnia now supports Socket.IO request types! INS-925 INS-1027 #8405 #8913
  • Disable electron’s nodeIntegration in the worker process used for rendering template tags, making them much safer for everybody to use. INS-292 #8822
  • Move spectral linting out of the main process and into a utility process. This lets the app boot just a little bit faster. #8853
  • Add support for additional chai-compatible methods, like withBody, to make testing easier. INS-944 #8875
  • The sidebar will load significantly faster even when loading large collections with hundreds or thousands of requests. INS-694 #8805
  • Response properties will now be available in the script editor’s auto-complete. #8910
  • PropertyList.get will now directly return the value when possible, instead of something like an array with a single member. INS-943 #8867

Bugfixes

  • Path parameters are now correctly imported when moving work from Postman into Insomnia. Goodbye unexpected request errors! 🎉 INS-848 #8849
  • OAuth tokens from the current request will now correctly be used in the request instead of ignoring it and using a token from the parent folder instead. INS-918 #8882
  • OAuth2 with PKCE will now work correctly when using “Inherit from parent”. INS-837 #8869
  • Auth inheritance will now work correctly even when requests are nested within folders multiple levels deep. INS-638 #8884
  • Fix an issue on Windows where Insomnia would not start automatically after an update. INS-856 #8846
  • Reopening the app after disconnecting a git project from its upstream and resetting won’t change the project type to a local one anymore. INS-999 #8903
  • Insomnia’s SSE connection will now only reconnect when necessary, like when switching organizations. INS-779 #8866 #8876 #8887
  • Non-standard response codes won’t cause Insomnia to break the request/response workflow anymore, so post-response scripts and tests will run as expected. INS-1000 #8844 #8896
  • Spec linting will correctly handle situations where an ongoing lint process is stopped because a new one has been triggered. #8877

Maintenance

  • Add documentation for the Environment & Vault SDK classes. #8854
  • Streamline how inso handles global options and remove code related to the exportFile option since it was removed in a previous version already. #8855
  • Refactor inso bundling logic to avoid bundling UI logic. #8892
  • Reorganize routes into a flat structure to pave the way towards using react-router’s framework mode. #8871 #8878 #8879 #8881 #8888 #8893

Full Changelog: https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/compare/core@11.3.0...core@11.4.0

Jul 10, 202511.3.0

Improvements & Features

  • Insomnia now provides an NSIS installer for Windows! This will let you choose where you want to install Insomnia, instead of always installing to the same location. 🎉 INS-5109 #8456
  • Easily see local and remote changes in the bottom left corner, including project type and Git status. This information is now displayed for Local & Cloud Sync projects as well! INS-812 #8852

Bugfixes

  • Changes pulled via git will immediately reflect within open tabs. INS-5227 INS-5626 #8851
  • Importing a collection into a Git Sync project now correctly displays a diff when committing changes, even if the collection wasn’t opened after importing. INS-5760 #8806
  • Requests triggered from within template tags will now use the selected environment when tests are run via inso, as expected. INS-5180 #8780
  • Environments which momentarily become invalid JSON—like when you’re in the process of typing—will now persist as expected once syntax is fixed. INS-5894 #8816
  • Folder environment variables will still save as expected even when you switch away from the tab. INS-5907 #8823
  • Disconnecting a Github account when creating a new project will keep the Create/Update Project modal open so you can connect another account, or the same one again, without having to start the flow all over again. INS-5877 #8841
  • Duplicating a design document will no longer lead to broken request references in the tests. INS-5236 #8833
  • Importing a folder will now correctly import all of the folder headers as well. #8714 #8821
  • Discarding changes will no longer also close the corresponding tab and lead to an unexpected loss of work in some cases. INS-757 #8804
  • Cookie values now strip Nunjucks interpolation sequences before being set. #8808
  • insomnia.global.set will now correctly update the environment even if only the global base environment is active. INS-5795 #8789 #8790
  • We now spell “enabled” correctly when explaining that some features are only enabled on certain plans. #8819 #8829

Maintenance

  • Add tests to cover commonly used template tag functionality. #8759
  • Add provision to support unknown types when pulling changes into a project. This is a forward-facing change to make it less disruptive when opening new request types in older app versions. #8703
  • Update dependencies to newer versions. #8835 #8840
  • Improve analytics events, e.g. to help us better understand cases where tests run into errors, so we can address problems without having wait for folks to report them. INS-5807 INS-5623 #8802 #8765

Full changelog: https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/compare/core@11.2.0...core@11.3.0

Jun 5, 202511.2.0

Improvements & Features

  • The experience of cloning pre-v11 git repositories has been improved significantly: The app now takes care of migrating the repository to the new format and gracefully handles switching across branches on different schema versions. INS-5145 #8720 #8761
  • `inso` now displays a simplified test result summary after executing a test suite. INS-5567 #8739
  • The git subsystem now uses the same HTTP client as the rest of the app, respecting system-level certificates and other app settings. #8710
  • The selected global base environment is now available in scripts via the insomnia.baseGlobals property. INS-5544 #8734
  • There are now stricter validation rules in place for plugin names. INS-5310 INS-5408 INS-5333 #8639
  • The Design Document → Tests tab now more strictly enforces what can be imported. #8758
  • Cookies with a __Host- prefix, i.e. hostOnly cookies, are now supported. A “HostOnly” checkbox has been added when editing a cookie in the Manage Cookies modal.
  • OpenAPI example specifications now have no lint errors by default, and additional examples (Empty, Todo List) are now available as starting points. INS-5526 #8719
  • Hide the OpenAPI specification preview panel when there is no specification to render, e.g. when a new design document is created. INS-5434 #8660
  • Add internal documentation for the Console, RequestInfo, and Variable classes. INS-5475 INS-5540 INS-5589 #8685 #8713 #8755

Bugfixes

  • On Windows, the `inso --version` command now correctly returns the application version instead of dev. #8397 #8704
  • The app no longer freezes due to open SSE connections. INS-5464 #8722
  • The key-value editors in the Params, Body, Headers, and other tabs are now vertically scrollable again when the length of the list exceeds the available space. #8681 #8688
  • If both `inso` and Insomnia are installed on the same host, `inso` now prioritizes proxy options supplied via CLI over the ones set in the Insomnia GUI. INS-5429 #8700
  • The search bar no longer disappears if no matching collection is found in a project. INS-633 #8682 #8684
  • Editing a cookie and setting the “domain” to an empty string now correctly shows the empty domain in the Manage Cookies modal. INS-5474 #8683
  • Errors encountered when rendering template tags in a worker are now surfaced correctly in the GUI. INS-5482 #8695
  • The request => folder template tag now correctly returns the folder name rather than the request name. INS-5586 #8756
  • Exporting environments now preserves keys even when the values are empty strings. INS-5463 #8727
  • The app no longer displays a warning about storage controls enforcing the usage of Git Projects when working within a Git Project. INS-5602 #8762
  • Replace unnecessary modules in templating thread with undefined. #8771
  • Errors encountered while selecting a Github repository are now displayed inline. #8776
  • The contents of buttons when attaching a file to a request body or using multiline inputs are now center aligned. Perfectly balanced, as all things should be. INS-5469 #8678
  • Use a different mechanism for un-escaping forward slashes when previewing JSON. The previous approach led to a loss of precision when rendering numbers. INS-5465 #8698
  • Some modals, like when creating a new git project, were horizontally truncating contents. This has now been fixed. INS-5414 #8725
  • Fix typos in the Upgrade modal. #8733 #8735
  • Update plugin access error message to be more verbose, more clearly directing users to the plugin settings. #8718

Maintenance

  • Upgrade React Router from v6.x to v7.x. #8702
  • Upgrade jsonpath-plus and Spectral dependencies. #8690
  • Introduce eslint-plugin-unicorn to enforce stylistic consistency across the codebase. INS-5576 #8743
  • Switch from unstable to stable nixpkgs. #8641
  • Rename “Start from an example” to “Start from boilerplate” when a design document is empty. #8661
  • Remove protobufjs version override since node-grpc dependencies were updated. #8716
  • Update tests using Insomnia mocks to use new staging URLs. #8737 #8741 #8742
  • Reduce test flakiness by waiting for navigation when necessary, and remove arbitrary waits. #8744 #8746 #8770

Full changelog: https://github.com/Kong/insomnia/compare/core@11.1.0...core@11.2.0

Jan 17, 20248.6.0

A big thanks to the 4 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨:

Fixes

  • WebSocket default headers are now shown as read-only in the UI (Make websocket immutable headers read-only in the UI #6872) @abluetuba
  • Fixes an issue where the workspace grid is shrinking when there is an overflow. (fix(workspace-grid): grid overflow should scroll properly #6972) @gatzjames
  • Fixes an issue with SSL Certificates on macOS that was related to the usage of the SecureTransport backend for libcurl. (fix(curl): revert to use openssl on macos [INS-3445] #6981) @notjaywu

Improvements

  • Re-introducing the new and improved Command Palette. This is a feature that allows you to quickly switch between requests, collections and documents. (feat(command-palette): Add command palette for quick switching between requests and workspaces #6968) @gatzjames
  • Improved the UI of the export modal and fixed some issues where requests wouldn't display correctly (Improve export modal UX #6978) @gatzjames
  • Show all parents of a request that matches the search filter (feat(sidebar-search): Show all parents of a request that matches the search filter #6983) @gatzjames
  • Improve the UX of adding and managing certificates (Add certificates modal and clean up workspace settings #6993) @gatzjames
  • Introducing Path parameters. Path parameters are path segments that start with a colon : and can be used to describe variable segments of URLs. (Request path parameters #6994) @gatzjames

All contributors of this release in alphabetical order: @abluetuba, @filfreire, @gatzjames, @notjaywu

Sep 27, 20238.0.0

8.0.0

After 12 months of hard work, we’re excited to announce the biggest release of Kong Insomnia that we have ever seen: Kong Insomnia 8.0, significantly rebuilt from the ground up and available today in GA. You can get started for free on insomnia.rest.

Announced today at API Summit 2023, Kong Insomnia 8.0 introduces hundreds of new improvements and features that will dramatically increase developer productivity when designing, testing, and debugging any API.

Kong Insomnia 8.0 highlights

  • Sharing Projects: We have entirely reinvented sharing and collaboration in Insomnia. It is now easy and quick to invite as many collaborators as we want to join our projects, collections or design documents.
  • Real time collaboration: With the new real time collaboration features, you can be more productive, reduce team coordination and always know in real time who is working with you on the same collections or design documents.
  • Introducing Organizations: Teams have been replaced with Organizations, you can now create as many as you need and invite people to collaborate with them.
  • Social and Enterprise SSO: Organizations now support EE SSO via SAML and OIDC, while other accounts can login via social SSO providers like Google or GitHub, in addition to the traditional email login.
  • Server Side Events API Support: Server Side Events APIs are now supported to give you even more ways to debug APIs with Insomnia, in addition to the previously supported REST, GraphQL, gRPC and WebSockets.
  • Insomnia AI: With Insomnia Al you can auto-generate API tests based on an OpenAPI specification that you create. Build more reliable APIs and save on development time.
  • New cloud dashboard: With an entirely redesigned cloud platform and dashboard at insomnia.rest managing all of your organizations and collaborators is a piece of cake.
  • Collaborators RBAC: Inviting users to your personal workspace or organization just got more powerful and intuitive with powerful RBAC rules to determine the level of access.
  • Unlimited Projects: We removed all limitations to the Insomnia application, you can now create as many projects as you want, with as many files as you want.

Fixes

  • Fixed issue #6465 where a render error would be through in some cases depending on the version format of an OpenAPI spec (#6493)
  • Fixed issue #3002 where pasting curl didn't work properly if the multi-line character '/' was present (#6500)
  • Upgraded Electron to 25.8.1 to address CVE-2023-4863 (#6504) @selfisekai

Improvements

  • Added minor improvements to the UI of Design/Spec tab in Design Documents (#6476)
  • Improved UI for Test view and also fixed issue #6482 related to autocomplete not working properly when writing unit tests (#6477)

Dec 15, 20222022.7.0

A big thanks to the 19 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨:

Breaking changes

  • The insomnia-components package is no longer maintained and has been deprecated since version 3.6.0 (#5259) @gatzjames
  • Different insomnia packages and default plugins are no longer published on npmjs.com. This includes insomnia-inso. If you previously installed Inso CLI through npm, please refer to the builds available in Insomnia Releases instead for future use (#5339) @jackkav

Fixes

  • Fixed a number of issues regarding hotkey shortcuts by replacing the KeydownBinder with hooks (#4937) @gatzjames
  • Fixed duplicate error response after upgrade (#5241) @jackkav
  • Fixed an issue with tooltip (#5239) @gatzjames
  • Fixed an issue where redirect commands from browser to the Insomnia App no longer worked (#5258) @gatzjames
  • Fixed an issue that prevented users from using CTRL/CMD+F keyboard shortcut (#5269) @gatzjames
  • Fixed an issue where GraphQL query variables disappeared from the variables editor (#5273) @gatzjames
  • Fixed an issue that prevented query parameters from being properly imported from Postman V2.1 collections (#5271) @filfreire
  • Fixed an issue where Path variables weren't properly escaped for Swagger specs (#5246) @AntoineJac
  • Fixed an issue where the Response template wouldn't return more than one result when parsing a JSON response by path (#5192) @bbbco
  • Fixed an issue where URL bar would always get auto-focused when sending a request (#5325) @arunnalla
  • Fixed an issue where OAuth2 access token expiry time was not set properly (#5332) @arunnalla
  • Fixed an issue where the Environment Editor would prevent saving edits after a validation error (#5363) @jackkav
  • Fixed an issue that prevented deep link redirects from browser to app (e.g. Login, installing Plugins, ...) to not work properly on Windows and Linux. (#5377) @jackkav
  • Fixed an issue where deeply nested environments variables didn't work for sub environments (#5219) @bbbco
  • Fixed an issue that prevented users from switching Client Credentials between Basic Auth and Request Body in OAuth2 requests (#5334) @arunnalla
  • Fixed an issue where certain template tags would result in JSON Parse error when used as number (#5136) @bbbco
  • Fixed an issue that prevented users from closing modals when importing collections leaving the user unable to undo an import by mistake other than continuing with the import (#5428) @jackkav
  • Fixed an issue that caused the response pane to sometimes flash for a brief moment (#5453) @jackkav
  • Added missing keywords to .desktop entry for Linux builds of Insomnia (#5454) @noraj
  • Fixed an issue that prevented preferences from being open in the correct tab (e.g. Import/Export) (#5462) @jackkav
  • Fixed an issue that caused dangling base environments when importing an Insomnia collection (#4378) @vincendep
  • Fixed an error that showed up when attempting to create a new plugin from the plugin preferences menu (#5473) @filfreire
  • Fixed code-signing for Windows builds (#5508) @filfreire

Improvements

  • Added WebSockets Subprotocol support (#5238) @jackkav
  • Added a logo splash at the app start (#5237) @jackkav
  • Added WebSocket Disconnect dropdown to support Disconnect All (#5236) @marckong
  • Added ability to search/filter WebSocket messages and or clear current ones (#5243) @gatzjames
  • Added a dropdown option to rename folders and requests more easily (#5256) @jackkav
  • Added better support for importing Postman v2.1 collections that have different OAuth2 setups (#5270) @gatzjames
  • Upgraded to Electron 21 (#5173) @jackkav
  • Added new UI improvements to the Dashboard (#5395) @gatzjames
  • Added API Key Authentication method for HTTP and WebSocket requests (#5399) @Asamsig
  • Added support for Client Certificate Authentication during OAuth 2 fetch token (#4961) @NicholasMata
  • Removed the Swagger preview from Design to provide a cleaner editing experience and in order to support OAS v3.1 (#5457) @jackkav
  • Added support for OpenAPI v3.1 specifications (#5459) @filfreire
  • Upgraded to Electron 22 (#5479) @filfreire
  • Each OpenAPI server is now imported as a sub-environment (#4254) @sixdouglas
  • Added support for setting CA certificates in workspace settings (#5498) @jackkav
  • Minor improvements to error handling and messaging (#5514) @jackkav
  • Added support for custom Ruleset files in Insomnia Git Sync'ed Design Documents. If you place a .spectral.yaml file in root of your repository, Insomnia will now load the custom ruleset to lint the OAS spec that is in the Design Document (#5520) @gatzjames
  • Added gRPC Server Reflection support (#5518) @jackkav

Inso CLI

  • Added a new --skipAnnotations option to inso export spec command. If the flag is set all x-kong-* annotations are removed. (#5398) @mod42
  • Improved the log output of inso lint spec command to print warning logs (#5408) @filfreire
  • Added support custom Ruleset files for Inso CLI. To use it run `inso lint spec ./oas.yaml` with a `.spectral.(yaml|yml|json|js)` file in the same folder (#5488) @jackkav

OpenAPI-2-Kong

  • Removed an implicit workaround that was causing plugin conflicts when inferring security schema (#5260) @jackkav
  • Added ability to enable automated security plugins at service-level (root of spec) when generating Kong (or Kubernetes) declarative configs (#5378) @ttyS0e

Dec 7, 20212021.7.0

gRPC Metadata

We now offer Metadata support for gRPC! This highly-requested feature enables more complex workflows, including workflows that use authentication.

Please report any bugs you may find using the issue tracker! 🤗

Notable Fixes

  • Fixed a regression where JSON responses wouldn’t format as JSON in certain cases
  • Fixed a regression where GraphQL queries would be colored as disabled
  • Fixed a regression where a blank workspace name would break the app header
  • Fixed a bug where the push and pull snapshot icons were identical
  • Fixed a regression where tab navigation didn’t work in certain cases
  • Fixed a bug where importing Postman or WSDL from the dashboard wouldn’t import anything
  • Fixed a regression where sidebar sorting wouldn’t work

Additions and Other Improvements

  • Improved header spacing to preserve vertical space
  • Added support for gRPC Metadata
  • Added masking for network proxy settings
  • Added support for importing GraphQL Postman collections
  • Added an option in Preferences to force HTTP/2
  • Added support for GraphQL prettify using a hotkey
  • Added support to specify multiple font families

Plugin API

  • Added support for config generator plugins to specify documentation links

Inso CLI

Included as of insomnia-inso v2.4.1

  • Added support for installing with homebrew on macOS
  • Added a `--format` option inso generate config to output declarative config as JSON
  • The `--src` flag can now be used to specify a git data source
  • Fixed an issue with the Linux single executable archive compression

OpenAPI to Kong configuration

Included as of openapi-2-kong v2.4.1

These updates to the OpenAPI to Kong configuration library are available both with the Inso CLI and the Insomnia app.

Kong Declarative Configuration

  • Now supports YAML sensitive strings by optionally outputting as JSON (#4129)
  • Upstreams are only generated when more than one server exists (#4105)

Thank you!

A huge shout out to the community members who contributed to this release of Insomnia!

  • @MrSnix #4036
  • @G0V1NDS #2871
  • @cgiraldo #4194
  • @sergiylandnych #4186
Oct 26, 20212021.6.0

Dark Colorblind Theme

About 8% of the population is red/green colorblind. We wanted to create more color accessibility for users. So we built a core theme that uses blue and yellow as primary colors. To use the Dark Colorblind theme, go to Preferences > Themes. 

GraphQL Schema Search

Last release, we added support for loading local GraphQL schemas. This time around, we’ve added GraphQL search, which allows you to easily navigate your schema documentation while making requests. 

Inso CLI Single Executable

Want to run the Inso CLI as a single executable? You can now download and run a single executable on MacOS, Windows, or Linux.

Please report any bugs you may find using the issue tracker! 🤗

Notable Fixes

  • Fixed a bug where some response history items could not be activated
  • Fixed a bug where some irregular characters would break the GraphQL editor
  • Fixed a bug with clicking links embedded within XML
  • Fixed a bug where the keyboard binding for “Show Autocomplete” could not be changed
  • Fixed a bug where the XPath filter didn’t support the `/text()` node
  • Fixed a regression where environment order did not persist

Introducing Projects!

Projects are a way to group your request collections and design documents. It builds on top of the existing Insomnia Sync functionality but also allows for local projects without sync enabled. On updating to this release any Request Collections you had previously pulled into Insomnia from Insomnia Sync, will be moved into the dashboard of that Project.

Read the blog post and documentation for more details about Projects!

Jun 28, 20212021.4.0

Hello, TypeScript! 🥳

The Insomnia codebase has been around for ~5 years now, and over time has gone through several iterations as JavaScript patterns evolved. In the most recent major iteration, we migrated a large majority of the codebase from Flow to TypeScript! There are countless benefits for having a codebase in TypeScript but the undertaking is huge, so the aim was to migrate like-for-like, to reduce the risk of introducing bugs.

This stable release of Insomnia marks the first release after the codebase was migrated to TypeScript, and contains several other improvements and fixes.

Please report any bugs you may find using the issue tracker! 🤗

Inso

Included as of insomnia-inso v2.3.0

  • Added a `--tags` option to specify tags when generating configuration files using `inso generate config`

OpenAPI to Kong

These updates to the OpenAPI to Kong configuration library are available both with the Inso CLI and in the Insomnia app.

Kong for Kubernetes

  • Improved the TLS configuration

Kong Declarative Configuration

  • “x-kong-plugin” tags will retain the plugin config and the “enabled” flag as specified in the OpenAPI specification
  • All generated Kong entities now have tags applied

Notable Fixes

  • Fixed a vulnerability due to an insecure call through electron (Thanks to Tobias Fink for reporting this!)
  • Fixed a vulnerability where the insomnia:// protocol could import from a spoof uri - now the uri will always be shown to the user (Thanks to Adam Baldwin for reporting this!)
  • Fixed a bug where proto directories for gRPC could not be selected on Linux
  • Fixed the dollar sign not correctly handled in URIs

Additions and Other Improvements

  • Improved the OpenAPI spec preview code font color
  • Added the ability to switch sub-environments from inside the manage environments modal
  • Added a theme preview tile when selecting light/dark OS color scheme themes
  • Improved the visibility of the “Send” button
  • Improved request chaining such to allow for chaining more than one request
  • Added a response time to the api response provided to unit tests
  • Added a tooltip to help configure Vim keybinds correctly on macOS

As users build APIOps pipelines using Insomnia, Inso and Kong, the need for improvements to the OpenAPI-2-Kong config generation became evident. As such, this release includes the following improvements (which are available within Insomnia, and also through the Insomnia CLI, Inso).

Kong Declarative Configuration

  • Added support to specify a `style` property for query parameters (preset depending on the parameter type) #3327
  • Fixed the path parameter regex to only match one segment #3298

  • Added support for plugins defined at the document root, path, or operation levels #3293
  • Added tags to generated targets, similar to services #3320

  • Fixed a bug where the service was using the actual hostname instead of the upstream name #3314
  • Improved plugin generation logic to include tags from various sources #3328
  • Added support for x-kong-{route, upstream, service}-defaults keys in the OpenAPI spec #3273

Mar 23, 20212021.2.1

This patch addresses a regression found in 2021.2.0 where users were unable to make requests against localhost on certain platforms like Windows and through local DNS servers across all platforms.

Once discovered we removed 2021.2.0 from the auto-update list and began our investigation. Through investigation we found the source of the regression was an update made to node-libcurl and worked with the maintainer to get a new build that resolves the issue.

We would like to give huge thank you to JCMais the maintainer of node-libcurl for being so helpful and working with us quickly to get out a build for this release. ❤️

Mar 2, 20212021.1.0

Single Application

Based on user feedback, usage observations, and internal discussion, we've merged Insomnia Designer and Insomnia Core. Following the Insomnia 2021.1 release there will no longer be an Insomnia Core or Insomnia Designer, only Insomnia.

When you start Insomnia users will be presented with the Dashboard, a new way to manage Design Documents and Request Collections (previously named workspaces). 

Once inside a Request Collection, Insomnia users will feel very much at home, while there are some changes, we tried to keep them to a minimum to retain the simplicity of Insomnia that we all enjoy.

If you were a user of Insomnia Designer you will be presented with a data migration flow asking you what data you would like to migrate. 

If you decide to skip the migration, you can always re-open the data migration flow through Application Preferences > General >  Migrate from Designer.

The Version Control Sync menu and button can now be found in the top right corner of the application header:

The remote pull menu has also been moved to the dashboard next to the create menu and is visible once logged in:

As a part of the merge, we have also bundled the Kong Plugin Bundle as a core plugin. Users familiar with Designer can now find their plugin actions under the document dropdown as seen below, this change was done to reduce header clutter and allow for future actions.

Improved protofile support

The Select Proto File dialog now supports multi-file and directory import for .proto files for GRPC requests.

Template tag support for gRPC

You can now use template tags for gRPC hosts and bodies.

Portable application support for Windows

Windows users now have the option to install Insomnia as a portable application, the portable binary can be found on the Insomnia Github releases page.

Automatic request collection generation improvements

We've made several updates to how we handle automatic generation of request collections to preserve user data while switching between the design and debug activities based on both user feedback and direct user input.

Now while switching between design and debug within a design document, changes from the specification to the request collection are now additive only, meaning that existing values and modifications to requests will not be overwritten.

In addition to preserving user data while switching between Design and Debug, the selected environment is also preserved.

Note: During QA, we identified a known issue where if you add an element in-between array elements inside of the specification and switch to the debug activity the element added will inherit the values of the array element that it took the place of. For now users can work around this issue by adding new elements to the end of the array.

Breaking changes

This release also contains the following breaking changes.

Legacy sync has been deprecated

With the release of Insomnia 2021.1, Legacy Sync has been deprecated in favor of version control which has been promoted to stable. Read more here.

Cloning repositories now requires a .git suffix

With this release to better support other platforms and workflows such as Azure DevOps cloning repositories now requires explicitly having the .git suffix.

Existing settings and repositories should not be affected by this change.

CLI - Default application directory has changed

With the merge of Insomnia Core and Insomnia Designer, the Insomnia CLI now looks at the Insomnia application data directory by default.
